headline: Rep. Debbie Dingell said Democrats must deliver results on voters' concerns quickly or face another electoral backlash in two years.
health_summary: Dingell listed 'our broken health care system' among the top voter concerns Democrats must address, alongside grocery costs, gasoline, rent, and corruption. She did not elaborate on specific health-policy proposals or legislation.

findings.context: Dingell characterized the health care system as 'broken' and listed it among top voter anxieties that the new Democratic majority must address.
findings.why_it_matters: Framing the health care system as broken signals potential legislative interest in systemic reforms that could affect hospital operations, reimbursement, or regulation in Michigan.
